items.title: Is Kroger (KR) Undervalued Or Is Its Cash Flow Already Priced In?
items.summary: Kroger has delivered strong long term share gains, yet the real question for investors today is whether the current price is fully backed by the cash the business is expected to generate over time. The stock has returned 76.9% over 5 years, which puts real pressure on the cash flow story to justify where the valuation sits now. items.title: Kroger (KR) Report Says Its Baby Food Exceeded FDA Lead Guidance
items.summary: Kroger (NYSE:KR) faces scrutiny after CRFB reported elevated lead levels in Kroger-brand baby food sold at Harris Teeter stores. The investigation alleges lead concentrations exceeded FDA guidance despite Maryland and Virginia laws intended to reduce heavy metals in baby products. CRFB claims Kroger disclosures understated tested lead levels, and consumer advocates are urging stronger quality controls and clearer labeling.
